mutations.name: the act skips the digest check, so a stale confirm still posts
kills: taps.act on an agent page refuses CHANGED when another agent took the name between prepare and act

mutations.name: a live agent is offered a retire
mutations.find: if (entry.state !== "exited") return `${name} is ${entry.state}; retire a working agent at the terminal`;
kills: taps.prepare on an agent page answers no-action for a live agent with no merged PR, without asking the factory
taps.prepare on an agent page a live agent inside the grace period offers no force retire

mutations.name: a seat is offered a retire
mutations.find: if (entry.seat !== null && entry.seat === entry.name) return "a seat is retired by its owner session";
kills: taps.prepare on an agent page answers no-action for a seat, without asking the factory

mutations.name: the page's op asks for --force
kills: taps.prepare on an agent page reads an exited agent back from the factory's preview with a confirm, previewing a plain retire

mutations.name: a moved outcome drops the current agent id
kills: taps.act on an agent page a moved agent shows moved with its current id
